Jora Ward stands braced at the edge of the breach, her heavy armor seeming to absorb and reflect the terrifying kinetic energy of the superheated coolant jetting into Command Level One. Ren’s console glows with the jagged line representing the micro-cycle dissonance, pulsing like a countdown timer.

You issue the order. Jora snaps into focus, her grip tightening on the injection apparatus containing the Restricted Chemical Compound. Helena Cross shifts, leaning in so close to the monitor that the heat haze from Node Three seems to waver around her profile. The entire Command Level holds its breath—a pressure vessel waiting for a single fraction of a second.

The geometric tear shifts its internal pattern—the fractal geometry that was previously volatile now stabilizes into an impossibly intricate, symmetrical lattice structure. And then, deep within the viewport, a single, tiny filament of brilliant violet light seems to detach from the latticework and drift toward Command Level One.
